timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I will guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you will hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let us begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I am close to snapping right now.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I feel irritated by what is happening.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: Part of me wants to say exactly what I am thinking.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I keep building a case in my mind.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body feels hot and tense.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I do not feel heard or respected.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I am afraid I will make this worse.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that I am angry.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: There is a lot of energy in this moment.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that is completely okay. Keep breathing, and we will continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can pause without giving up my point.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I do not need to respond at this temperature.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can let one breath interrupt the reaction.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can separate what happened from everything it reminds me of.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body is allowed to cool down.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I can name what I need more clearly.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: A pause can protect both of us.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can choose when and how to continue.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can make more room before I speak.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You do not need the feeling to disappear. See if there is simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can respond from steadiness instead of impulse.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My message matters enough to say clearly.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can be direct without being cruel.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can listen while staying connected to myself.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can hold firm without bracing.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I am allowed to set a boundary calmly.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can step away if I need more time.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I trust myself to choose a useful response.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I am ready to speak with intention.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
